verdict.rationale: EBANX documents HTTP POST notifications to a configured Notification URL with digital-signature headers (ebanx-docs-21), and automatic retries when the merchant's system fails to process one (ebanx-docs-22). That covers signed delivery and retries, about half the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of a webhook event log or delivery history, manual or programmatic replay/redelivery of events, details of the retry schedule, and independent corroboration.
